en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a large medieval clock tower on a hill, with a steep shingled roof and wooden gallery. The tower's prominent clock face with Roman numerals overlooks a cityscape of red-roofed buildings spread out in the valley below. Trees and greenery frame the foreground. Printed caption text appears at the top, and a handwritten date is visible in the upper left.
